entries.name: MCbiF multiscale deprivation fragmentation — full null battery
entries.objective: Run the full MCbiF bifiltration + spatial-permutation null battery (B=1000) on IMD 2025 English LSOAs (33,755) at k∈{3,5,7,10,15}. Determine whether H1 rank exceeds the 95th percentile of the permutation null (FDR-corrected, BH). Baselines: ARI-across-resolutions and Moran's I. Decision: ADDITIVE / REDUNDANT / INFEASIBLE (maps to prose direction per outcome-to-prose locked rule below). No paper-facing prose is produced by this task; prose direction is determined by the decision and locked here.

metric_space.data: IMD 2025 File 7 CSV — 33,755 English LSOAs, 7 domain scores
domain_columns: Barriers to Housing and Services Score

null_model.operation: spatial permutation — randomly permute LSOA row ordering before z-scoring and k-means; rebuild fresh MCbiF bifiltration from shuffled vectors per draw
null_model.invariance_requirement: permutation MUST be applied before clustering; post-construction permutation is degenerate and invalidates the null

baselines: ARI-across-resolutions: pairwise partition agreement across k-value pairs (all C(5,2)=10 pairs)
Moran's I spatial autocorrelation on each of the 7 domain scores

decision_rule.additive: H1 rank (observed) > 95th percentile of B=1000 spatial-permutation null (FDR-corrected, Benjamini-Hochberg) AND H1 signal not reproduced by ARI-across-resolutions or Moran's I at same significance level -> Outcome A: ADDITIVE; write [RESULT] vault entry; proceed to prose per outcome_to_prose.additive.
decision_rule.redundant: H1 rank non-trivial but fully explained by ARI-across-resolutions at matched significance -> Outcome B: REDUNDANT; write [RESULT] vault entry; update backlog to parked; no prose.
decision_rule.infeasible: H1 rank falls within null distribution at all k configurations tested -> Outcome C: INFEASIBLE; write [NEGATIVE] vault note; update backlog to killed; no prose.

outcome_to_prose.additive: MCbiF k-indexed deprivation fragmentation is a new spatial methodology contribution. Target: Track A paper (poverty_tda extension). Section: results/methodology contribution. Claim: MCbiF H1 detects spatially persistent multiscale deprivation fragmentation not captured by ARI or Moran's I. No prose drafted until this task emits ADDITIVE.
outcome_to_prose.redundant: No prose. Update backlog to parked with reason 'H1 redundant with ARI'. Computational-Log [RESULT] entry only.
outcome_to_prose.infeasible: No prose. Write [NEGATIVE] note at vault/00-Meta/Discovery/mcbif-deprivation-spike-negative.md. Update backlog to killed.
